svg.text: ENTERPRISE MULTI-TENANT VECTOR DATABASE ISOLATION & SHARDING (5,000 TENANTS / 100M VECTORS)
Stop the 5,000-Collection RAM Explosion: Partition-Key Sub-Graphs + VIP Shards Save 91.4%
5,000 SaaS Tenants / 100M Vectors: Tier 1 Flat HNSW Filter (54% Recall!) vs. Tier 2 5K Collections ($168K/mo) vs. Tier 4 Tiered ($14.5K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1 & 2 Traps: Disconnected Graphs & RAM Bloat
1. Single Flat 100M HNSW + `WHERE tenant_id=X` (54.0% Recall!):
• A 5K-vector tenant is 0.005% of a 100M HNSW graph; 99.995% of
graph edges belong to other tenants—breaking greedy HNSW walk!
2. 5,000 Separate Physical Collections (Tier 2: 2,150 GB RAM!):
• Every HNSW collection carries ~300MB fixed segment/WAL/graph
overhead -> 1.5 TB wasted RAM & etcd coordinator OOM crashes!
3. Dedicated Instance per Tenant (Tier 3: $245,000/mo):
• Paying 24/7 base node cost for 4,900 tiny/inactive tenants
Production Failure Impact (5,000 Tenants / 100M Vectors):
• Small-Tenant Recall@10: Plummets to 54.0% in flat HNSW (640ms P99)
• 5K-Collection Memory Footprint: 2,150 GB RAM (Tier 2)
• Monthly Vector Cluster TCO: $115,000–$168,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: Partition-Key Sub-Graphs + VIP Shards + NVMe
1. Shared Collection with Tenant Sub-Graphs (`4,900 Standard Tenants`):
• Uses `Qdrant Payload-Index Sub-Graphs / Milvus Partition-Key` to
co-locate each tenant's vectors in 1 collection (98.4% recall, 18ms!)
2. Dedicated Physical Shards + BYOK for Top 100 Whale Tenants:
• Promotes tenants `>500K` vectors or regulated `CMK/BYOK` tiers
to dedicated shards (0% noisy-neighbor compaction & O(1) drop!)
3. SQ8 Quantization + 72h Cold Tenant NVMe/DiskANN Offload:
• Shrinks cluster DRAM from 2,150 GB down to 240 GB (-88.8%!)
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Small-Tenant Recall@10: 98.4% (+44.4 pts vs. Flat HNSW Filter)
• Query P99 Latency: 18.0 ms | Cluster DRAM: 240 GB (-88.8%)
• Monthly Cluster TCO: $14,500 / mo (-91.4% savings vs. Tier 2)
